calls.title: Jon-Paul Akal and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The discussion centered on improving podcast performance, which currently has 700 downloads from 25 episodes, by outsourcing editing and promotion. Growth Wizards will continue sourcing guests, while Jon-Paul will manage editing and promotion for 20 episodes monthly, with estimated promotional costs around $5,000. The team outlined a multi-faceted promotion strategy including SEO, social media, and paid ads to attract product teams as the target audience. They emphasized full production services and insights from the Fame Host platform to enhance quality and analytics. A flexible pricing model allows for 20 episodes monthly at approximately $16,000, with a commitment to a 10% month-to-month growth guarantee, aimed at improving download numbers and engagement.
calls.keywords: podcast promotion, guest recruitment, Growth Book, podcast editing, content repurposing, targeted outreach
calls.action_items:
**Jon-Paul Akal**
Send Ashley a detailed email with pricing estimates for podcast promotion of 20 episodes per month and separate pricing for editing services, including case studies and deeper strategy details (20:40)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Review the detailed pricing and service proposal email from Jon-Paul and provide feedback or decision (22:35)
